name: 西游记 4.2
english_description: An independent Journey to the West mythology implementation with a fuller mythological map than most siblings in this family -- the Thirty-Three Heavens, the Garden of Immortal Peaches, Penglai, and the Heavenly Palace are all built out, plus a guild-hall zone (d/banghui/) unique to this archive. New characters can apprentice into the Lingtai Fangcun Mountain sect under disciple Yun Qing, and a poem-guessing minigame quizzes players with real Tang-dynasty poetry drawn from a library of hundreds of poems (confirmed real works by Pei Di and Gao Shi, not placeholder text). Death sends characters to the underworld (阴阳界), where Judge Cui reviews the register of life and death and resurrects them at a waystation.
